verdict.reasons: The candidate image displays the correct AFP drip tape roll as the commercial product, satisfying the primary identity requirement. However, a core defect exists in the irrigation geometry: the installed system shows a black tubular supply line feeding into the emitters, which is characteristic of a hose-drip system rather than a drip-tape system where the tape itself is laid out as the lateral. According to the instructions, this constitutes a mixed product family (correct tape roll observed, wrong installed system present) and a failure in technical_evidence_match. Minor advisory issues include slight blurring of secondary text on the package and minor soil contact, which do not trigger automatic rejection on their own but contribute to the overall technical mismatch.
